column1: # in CAISO's Final 2027 Local Capacity Technical Report (dated 2026-04-29; section 3.3.x.1 "Area Definition" of each area).
# The report names only the BOUNDARY substations of each area; interior substations are not listed and are therefore
# not encoded here. relation = in (inside the area) | out (explicitly outside that area's boundary).
# A station whose low-voltage bus is in and high-voltage yard is out (Gates 70 vs 230) is encoded OUT with a note
# because queue POIs sit on the high side. utility disambiguates same-name stations (Eagle Rock: PG&E vs SCE).
# substation = spelling as the CAISO queue files use it where known (joined on the same node key as the queue).
# No "#" inside a value: the reader treats it as the start of a comment.
